title: Rovaniemi, Lapland — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Rovaniemi, Lapland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Rovaniemi is a city in Lapland with a population of 63,000. The official hometown of Santa Claus, a gateway to Lapland known for its Arctic nature and Northern Lights. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
